title: Chinese Braised Pork Ribs

ingredients.rawText: A little white vinegar, for cleaning
ingredients.name: white vinegar

ingredients.rawText: Scallions, for blanching, braising and garnish
ingredients.name: scallions

ingredients.rawText: Ginger slices for blanching, plus 3 slices for braising
ingredients.name: ginger

ingredients.rawText: Water, enough to cover the ribs
ingredients.name: water

steps.text: Toss the ribs with salt, flour and a little white vinegar. Add water, rub gently, then rinse away the flour and drain.
Place the ribs in cold water with scallions, ginger and cooking wine. Bring to a boil over medium-low heat, skim the foam, then boil for another 1–2 minutes.
Lift out the ribs, rinse in warm water and drain.
Put the ribs in a clean pan with 3 ginger slices, a scallion section, star anise, dried chilies, beer, light soy sauce, dark soy sauce, oyster sauce and sweet bean sauce. Add water to cover.
Cover, bring to a boil, then reduce to low heat and simmer for 1 1/2 hours until tender.
Remove the aromatics during simmering once they have released their flavor. When the ribs are tender, uncover and turn up the heat to reduce the sauce until thick.
Plate the ribs, spoon over the sauce and garnish with chopped scallions.

notes: Reduce the sauce at the end until it coats the ribs. The sweet bean sauce provides color and flavor without caramelizing sugar.
